featured_reviews.name: Mohit Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text: I have been staying at this PG from last 1 year and my experience has been really good. The owner is very supportive and responsive whenever there is any need and on very quick basis. The environment is safe and comfortable, which makes it a good choice for students and working professionals. Overall, I am happy with my stay here and would recommend this PG to others.

featured_reviews.name: Bikranta Bhattacharjee
featured_reviews.review_text: I stayed at the Western Woods (Malad) property managed by Nitinji for a couple of years, and I must say, it was an excellent experience. The service was top-notch, and the apartment itself was one of the best I’ve seen at such an affordable and reasonable price. The property was very well-maintained and squeaky clean. On the rare occasion that something went wrong, Nitin ji was always just a call away and prompt in resolving any issues. I would highly recommend his PG and services to anyone looking to relocate to Mumbai.
